tests.name: Default v9.2 torch intensity and color retained
Natural torch and lantern retain the same prior palette
Omnidirectional torch still lights outside the future beam
Block brightness zero removes source radiance and emission
Block brightness no longer changes handheld brightness
Block brightness scales direct radiance and emission linearly
Custom block color reaches both direct light and source emission
Custom block color does not tint held light
Custom handheld color reaches actual surface illumination
Handheld brightness scales independently and linearly
Zero handheld brightness avoids both illumination and shadow rays
Flashlight lights the crosshair but not its sides or behind it
Flashlight extends to configured range with a finite cutoff
Flashlight retains one shadow ray; outside-beam pixels trace none
All three torch types enter beam mode
Lanterns and luminous blocks remain omnidirectional
Offhand torch also supports the flashlight
Beam field of view changes the illuminated region
Softness zero is finite and softness fades only the rim
Flashlight remains occluded by a solid wall
Flashlight retains stained-glass absorption and tint

scope: Production light controls, handheld illumination, beam rejection, ray counts and real opaque/glass traversal
